text.p: -- Robert W. Baird said Thursday it raised its rating on Regal-Beloit Corp to aggressive buy from accumulate.
-- cited the power transmission equipment and tool company's planned acquisition of Marathon Electric Manufacturing Corp.
-- "We've been waiting for a long time for these guys to add some top-line revenues," analyst Darren Bagwell said in a telephone interview.
-- Regal-Beloit had 1996 revenues of $282 million, while motor and generator maker Marathon had revenues of $245 million.
-- Regal-Beloit said it would acquire Marathon for $240 million in cash.
-- Bagwell said that while Regal-Beloit was not forecasting the financial impact of the Marathon merger, the company has a history of not making acquisitions that dilute earnings.
"Regal-Beloit's history is that they don't do dilutive acquisitions," Bagwell said. "So I expect it to be accretive."
-- Regal-Beloit shares were up two points to 22-7/8, a 52-week high, at midday.
